[ESTIMATE] Major highway access is approximately 2-5 km based on Çerkezköy's position as a significant industrial town. [INFERENCE] A planned 990 MWe lignite plant would typically require 50-150 ha based on the capacity-to-area ratio of 0.05-0.15 ha/MWe for coal plants, suggesting the site likely meets the 14 ha minimum threshold. [FACT] The site is located in Çerkezköy district, Tekirdağ Province, in the industrialized Marmara region of Turkey. [FACT] Çerkezköy is a significant industrial town with a population of approximately 100,000-120,000 people. [INFERENCE] Given the site coordinates (41.283333°N, 28.000000°E) place it within or immediately adjacent to the urban area of Çerkezköy, a substantial portion of this population would fall within the 5 km radius. [ESTIMATE] With a town of ~110,000 people substantially overlapping the 5 km zone (area ≈ 78.5 km²), the average population density would likely exceed 1,000 persons/km², triggering the avoidance threshold. The proximity to Istanbul metropolitan area (~60 km) and the site's location in Turkey's most densely populated industrial corridor further supports this assessment.
